exemple: « My mum wants me to tidy my room. She doesn’t let me play video games after nine. »
regle: **Want / would like + complément + to + base verbale** : she wants **me to come** (et non « that I come »). **Make + complément + base verbale** : obliger (they make **us work**). **Let + complément + base verbale** : permettre (let **me go**). **Enjoy, stop, finish + -ing** : I enjoy **reading**.
piege: Jamais « I want that you… » : on dit « I want you to… ».
